name: RequestForAccountManagementStatusReportV06
definition: Scope|The RequestForAccountManagementStatusReport message is sent by an account owner, for example, an investor or its designated agent, to the account servicer, for example, a registrar, transfer agent, custodian bank or securities depository to request the status of an AccountOpeningInstruction, GetAccountDetails or an AccountModificationInstruction.|Usage|The RequestForAccountManagementStatusReport message is used to request the processing status of a previously sent AccountOpeningInstruction, GetAccountDetails or an AccountModificationInstruction message for which an AccountDetailsConfirmation message has not yet been received.
